policies: Cancellation Policy Cancellations that are made 72 hours or more before your scheduled charter will receive a full refund.
Cancellations that are made less than 72 hours before your scheduled charter, as well as no-shows, are non-refundable.
If you have opted and paid the less than 72-hour non-refundable trip protection, you will receive an adjusted refund.
Weather & Safety Policy Passenger safety is our absolute priority.
The Captain makes the final decision regarding weather cancellations, usually evaluating conditions the night before or the morning of the charter.
In the event of a Captain-directed weather cancellation, you will receive the option to reschedule to an available date or receive a 100% refund.
Wind factor is the main component when considering if the weather is “fit” for fishing that day.
Should weather be unsafe we will attempt to rebook you or cancel if you’re unable to.

faq.q: Why should I choose Magic Sport Fishing for my Deep Sea Fishing experience?
faq.a: A: Here at Magic, we have the ONLY all local, born & raised captains, crew, and staff. Her captains’ have 75+ years of combined Hawaii fishing experience. They’ve maintained a 95%+ catch rate and continue to have the most notable record catches in the state and Hawaiian fishing tournaments. So you’re guaranteed all the acquired knowledge and natural skills it takes to have a productive day deep sea fishing, with guides who truly know Hawaii’s waters.
